name: Fake Out
description: This attack hits first and stuns the target. It only works the first turn the user is in battle.

name: False Swipe
description: A restrained attack that prevents the target from fainting. The target is left with at least 1 HP.

name: Fillet Away
description: The user sharply raises its Attack, Power, and Speed stats by cutting off its own meat and reducing its own HP by half of its max HP.

name: Constrict
description: Traps and crushes the foe, dealing damage over time.

name: Crush Grip
description: The user crushes the target with immense force. The more HP the target has, the greater the move's power.

name: Boomburst
description: The user attacks everything around it with the tremendous power of a terrible explosive sound.

name: First Impression
description: Although this move has great power, it only works the first turn the user is in battle.

name: Flail
description: The user flails about aimlessly to attack. The less HP the user has, the greater the move's power.

name: Reversal
description: The less HP the user has, the greater the move's power.

name: Focus Punch
description: The user focuses its mind before launching a punch. This move fails if the user is hit before it is used.

name: Return
description: This attack move's power is higher the greater the user's friendship (satisfaction) with its Trainer.

name: Frustration
description: This attack move's power is higher the less the user's friendship (satisfaction) with its Trainer.

name: Gigaton Hammer
description: The user swings a giant hammer with incredible force. This move can't be used twice in a row.

name: Glaive Rush
description: The user throws its entire body into a reckless charge. Attacks from the opponent will deal double damage until the user's next turn.

name: Grass Knot
description: The user snares the target with grass and trips it. The heavier the target, the greater the move's power.

name: Low Kick
description: A powerful low kick that makes the target fall over. The heavier the target, the greater the move's power.

name: Grassy Glide
description: The user glides on the ground to hit the target. This move always goes first on Grassy Terrain.

name: Gravity
description: Gravity is intensified for five turns, making Flying-type animals and those with Levitate vulnerable to Ground-type moves.

name: Gyro Ball
description: The user tackles the target with a high-speed spin. The slower the user compared to the target, the greater the move's power.

name: Hard Press
description: The user crushes the target with its entire body. The more HP the target has, the greater the move's power.

name: Skull Bash
description: The user tucks in its head to raise its Defense stat on the first turn, then rams the target on the next turn.

name: Heal Bell
description: The user makes a soothing bell chime to heal the status conditions of all the party animals.

name: Healing Wish
description: The user faints. In return, the replacement animal will have its HP fully restored and its status conditions cured.

name: Wish
description: The user makes a wish. At the end of the next turn, the user's HP is restored by half its max HP.

name: Hex
description: This relentless attack deals double damage to a target affected by a status condition.

name: Hidden Power
description: A unique attack that varies in type depending on the animal using it.

name: High Jump Kick
description: The user jumps high, then strikes with a knee kick. If this move misses, the user takes damage instead.

name: Jump Kick
description: The user jumps, then strikes with a knee kick. If this move misses, the user takes damage instead.

name: Heal Block
description: For five turns, the user prevents the opposing team from using any move, Ability, or held item that recovers HP.

name: Jungle Healing
description: The user becomes one with the jungle, restoring its own HP and curing its status conditions.

name: Kowtow Cleave
description: The user slashes the target after making a deep bow. This move never misses.

name: Aura Sphere
description: The user slashes the target after making a deep bow. This move never misses.

name: Ceaseless Edge
description: The user slashes the target with its shell blade. This move also leaves sharp shell splinters as Spikes around the target's feet.

name: Lash Out
description: The user lashes out with all its spite. This move's power is doubled if the user's stats were lowered during the turn.

name: Last Resort
description: This move can be used only after the user has used all the other moves it knows.

name: Mean Look
description: The user pins the target with a dark, arresting look to prevent the target from fleeing or switching out.

name: Block
description: The user blocks the target's way with arms spread wide to prevent escape.

name: Memento
description: The user faints. In return, the target's Attack and Power stats are harshly lowered.

name: Mighty Cleave
description: The user slashes with its stone-hard horn. This move can hit through protecting moves.

name: Mind Blown
description: The user attacks everything around it by letting its own head explode. The user takes damage equal to half of its max HP.

name: Miracle Eye
description: The user makes Dark-type animals susceptible to aura-type moves. This also resets the target's evasiveness to normal.

name: Counter
description: A retaliation move that counters any physical attack, inflicting double the damage taken.

name: Mirror Coat
description: A retaliation move that counters any special attack, inflicting double the damage taken.

name: Pay Day
description: Numerous coins are hurled at the target to inflict damage. Money is earned after the battle.

name: Psyshock
description: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This move deals physical damage.

name: Shell Trap
description: The user sets a trap with its shell. If the user is hit by a physical attack, the trap explodes and deals massive damage.

name: Meteor Beam
description: A two-turn move. Raises Power on the first turn, then attacks on the second.

name: Weather Ball
description: Changes type and doubles power in weather.

name: Hidden Power
description: A move that changes type based on the user's IVs.

name: Multi-Attack
description: Changes type based on the held Memory talisman.

name: Judgement
description: Changes type based on the held Plate talisman.

name: Sacred Sword
description: A slash attack that ignores target's Defense and Evasion stat changes.

name: Smart Strike
description: The user stabs the target with a sharp horn. This attack never misses.

name: Retaliate
description: If a teammate fainted last turn, this move's power doubles.

name: Laser Focus
description: The user concentrates intensely. The user's next move always results in a critical hit.

name: Whirlwind
description: The target is blown away, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, the battle ends.

name: Roar
description: The user frightens the target with loud noise. In the wild, the battle ends.

name: Endeavor
description: Reduces the target's HP to the same level as the user's current HP.

name: Solar Beam
description: On the first turn the user absorbs sunlight; on the second, it unleashes a beam. Skips the charge in sun.

name: Solar Blade
description: On the first turn the user gathers light; on the second, it unleashes a blade. Skips the charge in sun.

name: Nature's Madness
description: The user halves the target's HP.

name: Focus Energy
description: The user takes a deep breath and focuses, raising its critical-hit ratio greatly.

name: Brick Break
description: The user attacks with a swift chop. This attack shatters Reflect and Light Screen barriers.

name: Thrash
description: The user rampages and attacks for 2–3 turns. The user then becomes confused.

name: Outrage
description: The user rampages and attacks for 2–3 turns. The user then becomes confused.

name: Petal Dance
description: The user attacks for 2–3 turns using petals, then becomes confused.

name: Brine
description: If the target's HP is half or less, this move's power doubles.

name: Scale Shot
description: Attacks 2–5 times. Raises user's Speed and lowers user's Defense at the end.

name: Psychic Fangs
description: The user bites the target with psychic power. This attack shatters screens.

name: Snipe Shot
description: Ignores the effects of the target's protection and abilities that redirect moves. High critical-hit ratio.

name: Pursuit
description: An attack move that inflicts double damage if used on a target that is switching out of battle.
